samplers.setting: 500 test mazes at 224×224, 16 backbone calls, mean of 2 seeds; task-adapted models

items.label: Independent
items.desc: Each stream is integrated on its own while the other stays at its initial noise: the image runs along the bottom edge, the text up the left edge. They never see each other.

items.label: Image first
items.desc: The image is generated with the text at noise (bottom edge), then the text is generated from the clean image (right edge). The order is fixed in advance.

items.label: Text first
items.desc: The text is generated with the image at noise (left edge), then the image is generated from the clean text (top edge). The order is fixed in advance.

items.label: Coupled
items.desc: One backbone call advances both streams from the shared joint state, so each sees the other at every step. No order is chosen.
